routing_command.notes: Changing the source of mixer strip 5 re-sent five frames, groups 06, 0a, 0b, 0c, 0d in that order, identical except for slots 16-31: 00 00 in group 06, 09 00 in the others. The same difference is in each group's own readback (category 0x03, index = group), so a write built from the readback with one slot changed reproduces the captured frames byte for byte. Slots 0-15 are the 16 mixer strips. Only slot 4 (strip 5) was changed in a capture. Changing strip 1's source did NOT send these frames: it sent one frame to group 09 (four slots, source type 00), so slots 0-3 here (04 00..04 03) are fixed feeds from the four effect-rack channels and group 09 picks what feeds each rack. Group 09 is not understood well enough to write. Other groups seen only in readback: 0 (4 slots), 1-5 and 8 (2 slots), 7 (8 slots), 9 (4 slots).

state_report.notes: The device streams two unsolicited 320-byte reports at ~125 Hz each with no host traffic: magic 0x73 (state) and 0x83 (meter-like, mostly 0x60/0x32 lanes), the same pair as Zen Go. Unlike Zen Go, bytes 4..5 of 0x73 are 0x0000 (Zen Go: 0x4001). With the device at 48 kHz, 0x73 bytes 22..23 = 0xbb80 (48000) and byte 18 = 0x02 (the family's 48k index): candidates only, not tested against a rate change. Over 10 s idle, 0x73 offsets 160-163, 224-227, 242-243 moved. Base offsets deliberately not filled in.
